افتضحوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَحُوا (iftaḍaḥū) /if.ta.dˤa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# اِفْتَضِحُوا (iftaḍiḥū) /if.ta.dˤi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
